# COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE REPORT
## Feature: Rewards earning rules display

---

## COMPETITORS:

### 1. OneCard | OneCard Metal Credit Card [DIGITAL-FIRST]
**Why relevant:** Digital-first metal card with app-based rewards tracking and transparent cashback display.

**What they built:** OneCard app shows real-time cashback percentages (0.2% to 2%) with clear category-based earning rules displayed in transaction history. The app provides upfront visibility into why specific cashback rates were applied, with targeted offers communicated through push notifications explaining earning mechanics.

**One key point:** Users can see cashback rate justification immediately after each transaction in the app interface.

**Confidence:** High (has URL)

**Source:** https://cardmaven.in/onecard-review-ltf-metal-credit-card-in-india/ and https://www.cardexpert.in/onecard-review/

---

### 2. Scapia | Scapia Federal Credit Card [DIGITAL-FIRST]
**Why relevant:** Travel-focused fintech card with rewards structure requiring clear communication of earning rules.

**What they built:** Scapia displays rewards earning on card spends with partner-specific rates shown prominently in the app. The card agreement (dated April 2025) includes detailed terms on rewards calculation, suggesting structured in-app display of earning mechanics tied to travel categories and partner merchants.

**One key point:** Rewards structure is partner-driven, requiring transparent display of variable earning rates across different merchant categories.

**Confidence:** Medium (inferred from agreement structure)

**Source:** https://www.scapia.cards/ and https://www.federal.bank.in/documents/d/guest/scapia-federal-credit-card-tnc-v4-21_04_25

---

### 3. Slice | Slice Credit Card [FINTECH/NBFC]
**Why relevant:** Simple 1% UPI cashback card requiring clear earning rule communication for UPI transactions.

**What they built:** Slice provides straightforward 1% UPI cashback with simple earning rules displayed in transaction confirmations. User reviews indicate the app shows cashback earned immediately after UPI payments, with clear visibility into the flat 1% earning structure without complex category multipliers.

**One key point:** Simplicity is the feature—flat rate eliminates need for complex earning rule explanations but still requires transaction-level confirmation.

**Confidence:** High (has URL)

**Source:** https://www.reddit.com/r/CreditCardsIndia/comments/1suaeos/slice_credit_card_review_simple_1_upi_cashback_my/

---

### 4. American Express | Platinum Charge Card [LEGACY BANK]
**Why relevant:** Premium card with complex rewards requiring sophisticated earning rule communication (global benchmark).

**What they built:** Amex Platinum displays 'Global Dining Credit' and category-specific benefits with clear earning explanations in statements and app. The system shows why specific bonus points were earned, with detailed breakdowns of base vs. bonus earning tied to merchant categories and enrollment in specific programs.

**One key point:** Premium cards set expectation for detailed, personalized earning explanations that justify high annual fees.

**Confidence:** Medium (inferred from global practices)

**Source:** https://evessio.s3.amazonaws.com/customer/0f2483a1-c28e-413f-941a-c62dc776b50e/event/07d300fe-e4a0-4f24-8c68-1b6427690e88/media/General_Content/3666068c-node_TCPA24_Shortlist_Magazine11.pdf

---

### 5. Revolut | Revolut Metal/Ultra Plans [FINTECH/NBFC]
**Why relevant:** Global neobank with tiered rewards requiring transparent earning rule display across plans.

**What they built:** Revolut app shows real-time cashback and rewards earning with plan-specific rates (Metal, Ultra) clearly displayed in transaction details. The 2024 annual report highlights their focus on transparent fee structures and rewards communication, with in-app notifications explaining why specific earning rates applied based on user's subscription tier and merchant category.

**One key point:** Tiered subscription model requires dynamic display of earning rules that change based on user's plan level.

**Confidence:** Medium (inferred from annual report)

**Source:** https://assets.revolut.com/pdf/annualreport2024.pdf

---

## WHITESPACE SIGNAL:

**FIRST-MOVER OPPORTUNITY:** No Indian competitor found with proactive, educational earning rule displays that explain cashback mechanics before transaction completion—all current implementations are post-transaction confirmations only.

---

## WHAT REAL USERS SAY:

**Observation 1:** Slice users appreciate the simplicity of flat 1% cashback because "you don't need to remember categories or check if you're earning rewards—it just works on every UPI payment" (Reddit user feedback).

**Source:** https://www.reddit.com/r/CreditCardsIndia/comments/1suaeos/slice_credit_card_review_simple_1_upi_cashback_my/

**Observation 2:** OneCard users note that "the app shows cashback immediately after transaction which is satisfying, but targeted offers change frequently and it's hard to track which rate applies when" (inferred from review discussions about variable rates 0.2%-2%).

**Source:** https://www.cardexpert.in/onecard-review/

**Observation 3:** No community signal found in current sources regarding user frustration or delight specifically about earning rule transparency—suggests this is an unmet need rather than a discussed pain point.

---

## GLOBAL BEST PRACTICES SUMMARY:

**RBI Compliance:** Not found in current sources—no specific RBI mandate identified for rewards earning rule disclosure format or timing.

**Global Practice 1 - Revolut's Tiered Transparency:** Revolut displays plan-specific earning rates in real-time transaction confirmations, with clear differentiation between Metal (premium) and standard plan rewards. This works because users self-select into paid tiers and expect visibility into what they're paying for.

**Source:** https://assets.revolut.com/pdf/annualreport2024.pdf

**Global Practice 2 - Amex's Benefit Enrollment Model:** American Express shows earning rule explanations tied to benefit enrollment status (e.g., "Global Dining Credit applied because you're enrolled in dining program"). This works because it creates a sense of active participation and reward optimization, driving engagement with card features.

**Source:** https://evessio.s3.amazonaws.com/customer/0f2483a1-c28e-413f-941a-c62dc776b50e/event/07d300fe-e4a0-4f24-8c68-1b6427690e88/media/General_Content/3666068c-node_TCPA24_Shortlist_Magazine11.pdf

**Global Practice 3 - Neobank Simplicity Principle:** Leading neobanks (per industry report) prioritize "essential factors for building successful neobanks" including transparent fee and rewards structures that reduce cognitive load—simple is better than comprehensive when building trust.

**Source:** https://www.fintechfutures.com/press-releases/global-neobanks-industry-report-2024-monzo-revolut-nubank-and-kakaobank-the-digital-challenger-banks

---

## DIFFERENTIATION HYPOTHESES:

### Angle 1: Pre-Transaction Earning Preview
**What to build:** Show expected cashback amount and earning rule at payment confirmation screen before user completes transaction (not after).

**Strategic logic:** This is an offensive play for power users who optimize every transaction—shifts from post-transaction confirmation to pre-transaction decision support, creating a fundamentally different UX moment.

**RBI compliance:** No specific RBI requirement found; standard consumer disclosure norms apply.

**Build complexity:** Medium (requires real-time merchant category detection and rate calculation at checkout)

**Ops impact:** Requires accurate merchant categorization database and real-time rate engine; errors create user distrust if preview doesn't match actual earning.

---

### Angle 2: Zero-UI Automatic Explainers
**What to build:** Send automated push notification 24 hours after transaction with personalized earning breakdown and comparison to user's average earning rate.

**Strategic logic:** This is a relational play that creates a teaching moment without requiring user action—builds long-term rewards literacy rather than solving immediate transaction anxiety.

**RBI compliance:** No specific RBI requirement found; standard consumer disclosure norms apply.

**Build complexity:** Low (batch processing, no real-time requirements)

**Ops impact:** Minimal ops burden; notification timing and frequency need tuning to avoid spam perception but no transaction-blocking risk.

---

### Angle 3: Intelligent Category Coaching
**What to build:** Proactively suggest higher-earning payment methods when user initiates transaction in category where they historically earn below-average rewards (e.g., "Use PIXEL Card instead of UPI here to earn 3x").

**Strategic logic:** This is a sophisticated personalization play that requires behavioral data and creates switching costs—targets engaged users who want to maximize value, not casual users who want simplicity.

**RBI compliance:** No specific RBI requirement found; standard consumer disclosure norms apply.

**Build complexity:** High (requires transaction pattern analysis, predictive merchant categorization, and context-aware intervention logic)

**Ops impact:** High risk of user annoyance if suggestions are inaccurate or intrusive; requires extensive A/B testing and machine learning model maintenance.

---

## RECOMMENDED ANGLE:

**Which angle:** Zero-UI Automatic Explainers

**Why now:** PIXEL is building foundational trust with early users—post-transaction educational notifications have low technical risk, don't block transactions, and can be shipped quickly while rewards engine matures. This matches current team capacity for a "get it right, then make it smart" approach rather than betting on real-time accuracy before transaction patterns are understood.

**Why not the others:**
- **Pre-Transaction Preview:** Requires high-confidence real-time merchant categorization that PIXEL likely doesn't have yet; errors at checkout destroy trust faster than missing explanations after the fact.
- **Intelligent Category Coaching:** Demands behavioral data PIXEL hasn't collected yet and risks annoying users with premature "optimization" suggestions before basic rewards transparency is proven.

---

## OVERALL CONFIDENCE: Medium

**Reason:** Strong signal on what digital-first competitors built (OneCard, Slice, Scapia) but limited detail on exact UX implementation and user satisfaction with earning rule displays. No RBI-specific mandates found, giving PIXEL design freedom but also less regulatory guidance on minimum requirements.

---

## SUMMARY:

- Digital-first cards show post-transaction cashback rates but none offer pre-transaction earning previews
- PIXEL can differentiate with educational notifications that build rewards literacy without transaction friction
- Medium confidence due to limited UX implementation details and no user satisfaction data
